cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ush C)

# ush — Uros shell (#275.5).  musl-linked binary that drives session
# leadership, controlling-tty acquisition, /dev/tty, fork+execve, and
# tcsetpgrp-based foreground/background job control.

if(NOT UROS_BUILD_MUSL)
  return()
endif()

add_executable(ush_bin
  ush.c
)

# char_server.h is generated by libposix-uros's MIG rule; reuse it
# instead of re-generating locally (the stubs themselves come from
# libposix-uros's static archive).
add_dependencies(ush_bin mig_mach_public_headers musl_extproj libposix-uros)

set(MUSL_PREFIX ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/contrib/musl-install)

execute_process(
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} -m32 -print-file-name=include
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE _GCC_INCLUDE
  OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
execute_process(
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} -m32 -print-libgcc-file-name
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE _LIBGCC_A
  OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

target_compile_options(ush_bin PRIVATE
  -std=gnu11
  -m32 -march=i686 -msse -msse2
  -fstack-protector-strong
  -fno-builtin
  -w
  -include stdint.h
  -nostdinc
)

target_include_directories(ush_bin PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
  ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/lib/libposix-uros  # char_server.h, proc.h
  ${MUSL_PREFIX}/include
  ${_GCC_INCLUDE}
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/lib/libposix-uros/include
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/mach_services/include
  ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/include
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/export/include
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/mach_kernel
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/char_server
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/proc_server      # proc_types.h (PROC_SHUTDOWN_*)
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)

target_link_libraries(ush_bin PRIVATE
  -Wl,--start-group
  libcap
  libnetname
  libvfs
  libflipc2
  libmach_core
  libposix-uros
  ${MUSL_PREFIX}/lib/libc-musl.a
  ${_LIBGCC_A}
  -Wl,--end-group
)

target_link_options(ush_bin PRIVATE
  -m32 -static -nostdlib
  -Wl,-e,__start_mach
  -Wl,-u,__uros_libc_init
  -Wl,--build-id=none
)

set_target_properties(ush_bin PROPERTIES
  OUTPUT_NAME "ush"
  RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/export/${EXPORT_PLATFORM}/${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}/user/sbin"
)

# ===========================================================================
# Embedded .uros_manifest section (#235).
# ===========================================================================

set(USH_MANIFEST_SRC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ush.manifest)
set(USH_CMF         ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ush.cmf)

add_custom_command(TARGET ush_bin POST_BUILD
  COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:mkmanifest> -o ${USH_CMF} ${USH_MANIFEST_SRC}
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_OBJCOPY} --add-section .uros_manifest=${USH_CMF}
            --set-section-flags .uros_manifest=noload,readonly,contents
            $<TARGET_FILE:ush_bin>
  DEPENDS mkmanifest ${USH_MANIFEST_SRC}
  COMMENT "embed .uros_manifest into ush"
  VERBATIM
)
